name: Alpha BRAIN
subtitle: 30 capsules
tagline: The most recognisable name in the category, in its smallest size.
shortDesc: Onnit's flagship nootropic in the 30-count bottle — the cheapest honest way to find out whether this category does anything for you.
longDesc: Alpha BRAIN is the product most people mean when they say "nootropic". It is also the one with the most argument attached to it, which is exactly why we stock the small bottle: response to this category is individual, and the only way to find out which side of the argument you are on is to try it for a couple of weeks.

We stock it because Onnit publishes its ingredient list, has run its own human trials, and does not hide behind a single unlabelled blend total. Whether it works for you specifically is a separate question, and one a 30-count bottle answers cheaply.

whyWeStockIt.title: The cheapest real trial
whyWeStockIt.text: The 30-count bottle is enough to notice a pattern without committing to a month's spend.

whyWeStockIt.title: A brand that publishes
whyWeStockIt.text: Onnit lists its ingredients and has funded human research on the formula — rarer in this category than it should be.

whyWeStockIt.title: Easy to send back
whyWeStockIt.text: Our 60-day return policy applies to opened bottles, so a trial that goes nowhere costs you nothing.

usage: Follow the serving on the manufacturer's label. Most people take it in the morning, with or without food.
whoFor: First-time buyers who want to test the category before spending real money.

faq.q: How long before I notice anything?
faq.a: Response varies a lot between individuals and some people notice nothing at all. Give it the full bottle before deciding, and watch sleep and caffeine as confounders.

faq.q: Is this the same product sold elsewhere?
faq.a: Yes — genuine Onnit stock, in the manufacturer's sealed packaging, with the same label and lot coding you would get buying direct.

name: Energy & Focus
subtitle: 12-pack
tagline: Stimulant-forward, single-serve, and deliberately not a daily.
shortDesc: Gorilla Mind's energy and focus formula in single-serve packs — built for demanding days rather than everyday use.
longDesc: This is the loudest thing we stock. It is stimulant-forward, it is meant for days that genuinely demand it, and the single-serve format is the reason we carry it rather than a tub: the dose is fixed, and the pack count tells you honestly how often you are reaching for it.
Twelve servings is not a shortcoming. If you are finishing a box a week, the problem is your sleep, not your supplement, and nothing on this site will fix that.

whyWeStockIt.title: Fixed doses
whyWeStockIt.text: Single-serve packs mean no scoop, no guessing, and no dose that creeps upward over a month.

whyWeStockIt.title: Honest about what it is
whyWeStockIt.text: Gorilla Mind does not market this as a gentle daily. Neither do we.

whyWeStockIt.title: Travels flat
whyWeStockIt.text: Packs fit a laptop sleeve, a glovebox or a jacket pocket.

usage: Mix one pack into water per the manufacturer's label. Avoid within six hours of bedtime, and count its caffeine against your daily total.
whoFor: People with occasional high-demand days who do not want a daily stimulant habit.

faq.q: Can I take this every day?
faq.a: We would not. Stimulant tolerance builds quickly, and the value of a formula like this depends on it staying occasional.

faq.q: How much caffeine is in it?
faq.a: Check the current label — the amount is printed on the pack, and it counts against your daily total including coffee.

name: Qualia Mind + Qualia Night
subtitle: Day and night bundle
shortDesc: Neurohacker's daytime and evening formulas bought together — because for most people the focus problem starts the night before.
longDesc: Almost everyone shopping for a focus supplement is really shopping for the consequences of a bad night. Treating only the daytime half of that loop is how people end up escalating stimulants for months without getting anywhere.

This bundle is the reason we carry Neurohacker at all: they make both halves, designed to be taken together, and selling them as a pair is more honest than selling the daytime one alone to someone who is not sleeping.

whyWeStockIt.title: Addresses the actual loop
whyWeStockIt.text: Daytime and evening formulas from the same maker, intended to be used together.

whyWeStockIt.title: Nothing habit-forming at night
whyWeStockIt.text: The evening formula contains no prescription sleep agents.

whyWeStockIt.title: Cheaper as a pair
whyWeStockIt.text: Bundled below the sum of the two bought separately.

usage: Follow each product's own label — they have different serving sizes and different timings.
whoFor: Anyone whose focus problem starts at 11pm the night before.

faq.q: Can I buy the halves separately?
faq.a: Qualia Mind on its own is stocked in the larger sizes. The evening formula is currently bundle-only here.

faq.q: Will the night formula make me groggy?
faq.a: It is not intended to be sedating, but individual response varies. Try it first on a night without an early start.

name: Mind Lab Pro
subtitle: Universal Nootropic · 60 capsules
tagline: One bottle, one month, no stack to manage.
shortDesc: A single broad-spectrum, stimulant-free daily formula for people who want one bottle on the shelf instead of six.
longDesc: The usual nootropic path is six bottles, a spreadsheet and a slowly growing suspicion that none of it is doing anything. The alternative is one broad formula taken consistently for long enough to actually judge.

Mind Lab Pro is the one we point most people at for that job: stimulant-free, so it does not fight with your coffee, and fully disclosed — every ingredient amount is printed rather than buried in a blend total. That disclosure is the reason it is on this shelf.

whyWeStockIt.title: Fully disclosed doses
whyWeStockIt.text: Every ingredient amount printed on the label, with no proprietary blend hiding the numbers.

whyWeStockIt.title: Stimulant-free
whyWeStockIt.text: No added caffeine, so it does not interfere with your existing coffee habit or your evening.

whyWeStockIt.title: One bottle instead of six
whyWeStockIt.text: A single broad formula rather than a stack you have to manage.

usage: Follow the serving on the manufacturer's label. Consistency matters more than timing.
whoFor: People who have tried single-ingredient nootropics and want one considered formula instead.

faq.a: No — it is formulated stimulant-free, so you control your own caffeine separately.

faq.q: Can I take it alongside the Gorilla Mind packs?
faq.a: On demanding days, yes — but read both labels and count your total caffeine.

name: Alpha BRAIN Black Label
subtitle: Premium formulation
shortDesc: The higher-specification version of Alpha BRAIN, using different raw materials and a reworked formula.
longDesc: Black Label is what Alpha BRAIN looks like without a cost ceiling. It is a genuinely different formulation rather than a bigger bottle of the same thing, and it costs roughly four times as much per capsule.
It is not the right first purchase, and we will say so on this page every time. Start on the 30-count Alpha BRAIN or Mind Lab Pro, and move up only if the category is clearly doing something for you.

whyWeStockIt.title: A real reformulation
whyWeStockIt.text: Different actives and different raw material grades, not a relabelled version of the standard product.

whyWeStockIt.title: For people who already know
whyWeStockIt.text: Worth stocking for returning customers who respond to the category and want the upgrade.

whyWeStockIt.title: Honest positioning
whyWeStockIt.text: This is a step up, not a starting point, and the page says so before the buy button.

usage: Follow the serving on the manufacturer's label.
whoFor: Returning customers who already know they respond to the category.

faq.q: Is it worth the jump from standard Alpha BRAIN?
faq.a: Only if the standard version already works for you. If you noticed nothing on a full bottle, a more expensive formula in the same category is unlikely to change that.

faq.q: Can I alternate between the two?
faq.a: Yes. Some people run Black Label on heavy weeks and the standard formula otherwise.

name: Qualia Mind
subtitle: 154 capsules
tagline: The comprehensive end of the shelf.
shortDesc: Neurohacker's flagship: a long, fully disclosed ingredient list at a large daily serving, for people who want breadth in one product.
longDesc: Qualia Mind is the widest formula we carry — a long ingredient list at a multi-capsule serving, aimed at people who would otherwise be buying eight separate bottles and taking them inconsistently.

Breadth has a cost beyond the price. With this many actives it is genuinely hard to attribute an effect to any single ingredient, so if what you want is to learn what works for you specifically, work up from the simpler formulas instead.

whyWeStockIt.title: Breadth in one product
whyWeStockIt.text: Replaces a self-assembled multi-bottle stack with a single serving.

whyWeStockIt.title: Full disclosure at this size
whyWeStockIt.text: A long ingredient list with amounts printed, which is unusual for formulas this broad.

whyWeStockIt.title: Straight talk on attribution
whyWeStockIt.text: With this many actives you will not learn which one matters. We would rather say so than pretend otherwise.

usage: Follow the serving and timing on the manufacturer's label — the serving is several capsules and many people split it.
whoFor: Experienced buyers who already know they respond, and want coverage rather than clarity.

faq.q: That is a lot of capsules. Can I take fewer?
faq.a: You can take a partial serving, but then you are taking a partial dose of everything, including whatever made you buy it.
Cycling patterns are common with formulas this broad. Check the manufacturer's guidance on the label.

name: Complete Day & Night Stack
subtitle: 240 capsules
tagline: An extended supply of the whole routine.
shortDesc: Thrivous's day and night formulas together in a large supply, at the lowest cost per day on the shelf.
longDesc: This is the size to buy once you already know the routine suits you, because a large supply in one purchase is only good value if you are going to finish it.
Cost per day is the lowest we offer. Cost per mistake, if the category turns out not to work for you, is the highest — which is why the 30-count bottle exists.

whyWeStockIt.title: Lowest cost per day
whyWeStockIt.text: The best per-serving price on the shelf for people already committed.

whyWeStockIt.title: Day and night together
whyWeStockIt.text: Both formulas matched to the same supply period, so they run out together.

whyWeStockIt.title: Fewer reorders
whyWeStockIt.text: One delivery instead of several.

usage: Follow each product's own label. The day and night formulas have different servings and different timings.
whoFor: Repeat customers who have finished at least one month and want to stop reordering so often.

faq.q: Will it stay good that long?
faq.a: Check the printed expiry on arrival, which should be well beyond the supply period. Store both bottles somewhere cool and dry.

faq.q: Is this better value than subscribing?
faq.a: Subscribe & Save applies on top, so the cheapest per-day option is this size on subscription.

name: Qualia Mind
subtitle: 2-bottle supply
tagline: Two bottles of Qualia Mind, bought together.
shortDesc: An extended supply for people who have settled on Qualia Mind and want to stop reordering.
longDesc: There is nothing clever about this listing: it is the same product in a quantity that makes sense once you have decided.
Do not start here. Buy one bottle, finish it, then decide whether the second is worth the shelf space.

whyWeStockIt.title: For people who have decided
whyWeStockIt.text: Two sealed bottles at a better per-bottle price.

whyWeStockIt.title: One delivery
whyWeStockIt.text: Fewer reorders and one renewal date.

whyWeStockIt.title: Identical product
whyWeStockIt.text: The same formula as the single bottle — no bulk-grade substitution.

usage: As per the single bottle — follow the manufacturer's label.

faq.q: Can I split this with someone?
faq.a: Yes — they are two sealed bottles.

faq.q: What is the return position on a bulk order?
faq.a: The same as everything else: 60 days, opened or unopened.

name: Qualia Mind
subtitle: 4-bottle supply
tagline: The largest quantity we will sell you.
shortDesc: Four sealed bottles of Qualia Mind — a long supply, for people who are certain.
longDesc: This is the top of the range and the only honest thing to say about it is that most people should not buy it. A long supply of anything is a bet on a version of yourself several months from now.
If you are still here: four sealed bottles, same formula, one delivery, and the same 60-day return window as every other order.

whyWeStockIt.title: Best per-bottle price
whyWeStockIt.text: The lowest unit price we can offer on this product.

whyWeStockIt.title: Sealed bottles
whyWeStockIt.text: Opened one at a time, so the rest keep to their printed expiry.

whyWeStockIt.title: The 60-day window still applies
whyWeStockIt.text: Buying big does not shorten your return rights.

usage: As per the single bottle. Open one at a time and keep the rest sealed and cool.
whoFor: Long-term users who have already bought this product more than once.

faq.q: Should I really buy this much at once?
faq.a: Probably not, unless you have already finished several bottles. The 2-bottle supply is the sensible ceiling for most people.

faq.q: Will all four bottles have the same expiry?
faq.a: They ship from the same lot wherever stock allows, so expiries usually match. Check the printed dates on arrival.
